title: [Intelligent design of transcription factor-based biosensors].
authors: Liang, Chaoning; Xiang, La; Tang, Shuangyan
journal: Sheng wu gong cheng xue bao = Chinese journal of biotechnology
one_liner_zh: 综述了计算模拟与AI辅助设计转录因子生物传感器，涉及蛋白结构预测和配体结合模拟，但聚焦于配体响应而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移但非核心。
abstract: Transcription factor (TF)-based biosensors have been widely applied in metabolic engineering, synthetic biology, metabolites monitoring, etc. These biosensors are praised for the high orthogonality, modularity, and operability. However, most natural TFs with weak responses and low specificity still demand optimization for desired performance in applications. Herein, we comprehensively summarize the recent advances in the engineering and optimization of TF-based biosensors with the assistance of computational simulation and artificial intelligence. This review includes the regulatory protein engineering aided by protein structure prediction and ligand binding simulation and the regulatory protein responses predicted by a mathematical model obtained from machine learning of mutagenesis data. In comparison with conventional tools, computational simulation and artificial intelligence enable more accurate and rapid design and construction of biosensors. Thus, these technologies will greatly promote the development of novel biosensors for applications.
abstract_zh: 基于转录因子（TF）的生物传感器已广泛应用于代谢工程、合成生物学、代谢物监测等领域。这些生物传感器因其高正交性、模块化和可操作性而备受赞誉。然而，大多数天然转录因子响应弱、特异性低，在应用中仍需优化以达到预期性能。在此，我们全面总结了在计算模拟和人工智能辅助下，转录因子生物传感器工程化与优化的最新进展。本综述涵盖借助蛋白质结构预测和配体结合模拟进行的调控蛋白工程，以及通过机器学习诱变数据获得的数学模型预测的调控蛋白响应。与传统工具相比，计算模拟和人工智能能够更准确、更快速地设计和构建生物传感器。因此，这些技术将极大促进新型生物传感器在应用中的开发。
